samples.talkTrack: Lead with the buyer risk: Summit Outdoor Supply needs one trusted view before the customer promise is made. Prove it with Product / SKU, then capture the current baseline before claiming savings. Position NetSuite as the operating system for seasonal dealer demand, channel availability, allocation, and replenishment timing.
samples.roiAnswer: Frame ROI as risk reduction first: protect the seasonal dealer demand, channel availability, allocation, and replenishment timing decision, capture the current baseline before claiming savings, then quantify fewer misses, delays, exposure, or manual touches only after the buyer confirms that baseline.
samples.competitiveAnswer: NetSuite wins by keeping dealer demand, item availability, order promise, and financial impact in one operating path instead of splitting the work across ecommerce, spreadsheets, and inventory add-ons.

samples.title: Prove the NetSuite path
samples.show: Build results are ready.: Customer: Summit Outdoor Supply Customer Account -> Sales Order: SO2679 -> Product SKU: Summit Outdoor Supply Channel Availability SKU -> Availability Flow: Summit Outdoor Supply Dealer Replenishment Flow.

samples.proofMove: Prove Style / SKU Matrix readiness with Core Boot and Apparel Style Matrix. Use Ariat International Style SKU and keep the proof in NetSuite, not in a detached feature tour.
samples.objectionAnswer: If the buyer doubts the matrix, ask which size/color promise fails first today, then prove the current path through NetSuite records.
